extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, and other non-party commenters who wish to submit comments on the EPA proposed settlement agreement
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for members of the public on how to obtain the proposed settlement agreement and how to prepare and submit written comments to EPA (including format, identification, deadlines, and confidentiality limits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment deadline / timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: Written comments on the proposed settlement agreement must be received by January 18, 2017.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments received after the close of the comment period will be marked “late.” EPA is not required to consider these late comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may submit comments during the 30-day period
rubrics_metrics.description: For a period of 30 days following the date of publication of this notice, the Agency will receive written comments relating to the proposed settlement agreement from persons who were not named as parties or intervenors to the litigation in question.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA or the Department of Justice may withdraw or withhold consent to the proposed settlement agreement if comments disclose facts or considerations that indicate such consent is inappropriate, improper, inadequate, or inconsistent with the requirements of the Act.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to identify your submission (docket ID)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your comments, identified by Docket ID number EPA-HQ-OGC-2016-0642, online at www.regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For comments submitted at www.regulations.gov, follow the online instructions for submitting comments. Once submitted, comments cannot be edited or removed from www.regulations.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred submission method (regulations.gov)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of the www.regulations.gov Web site to submit comments to EPA electronically is EPA's preferred method for receiving comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The electronic public docket system is an “anonymous access” system, which means EPA will not know your identity, email address, or other contact information unless you provide it in the body of your comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not submit Confidential Business Information (CBI) electronically
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not submit electronically any information you consider to be Confidential Business Information (“CBI”) or other information whose disclosure is restricted by statute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information claimed as CBI and other information whose disclosure is restricted by statute is not included in the official public docket or in the electronic public docket. Copyrighted material will not be placed in EPA's electronic public docket but will be available only in printed, paper form in the official public docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia submissions must include a written comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Multimedia submissions (audio, video, etc.) must be accompanied by a written comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The written comment is considered the official comment and should include discussion of all points you wish to make.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not place comment content outside the primary submission
rubrics_metrics.description: The EPA will generally not consider comments or comment contents located outside of the primary submission (i.e. on the web, cloud, or other file sharing system).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all substantive material is included in the primary submission so EPA can consider it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include contact information (recommended) for electronic submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA recommends that you include your name, mailing address, and an email address or other contact information in the body of your comment and with any disk or CD ROM you submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This ensures you can be identified as the submitter and allows EPA to contact you if it cannot read your comment due to technical difficulties or needs further information. Any identifying/contact information provided in the body of a comment will be included as part of the comment placed in the official public docket and the electronic public docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email submissions capture identifying information
rubrics_metrics.description: If you send an email comment directly to the Docket without going through www.regulations.gov, your email address is automatically captured and included as part of the comment that is placed in the official public docket.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlike www.regulations.gov (anonymous access), email submission is not anonymous and contact information will be made part of the public docket entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency review, redaction, and withholding of submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies review all submissions and may choose to redact, or withhold, certain submissions (or portions thereof). Submitted comments may not be available to be read until the agency has approved them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that posted comments may be redacted or withheld and that availability on Regulations.gov may be delayed pending agency approval. See the full EPA public comment policy for more detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public availability and exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA's policy is that public comments, whether submitted electronically or in paper, will be made available for public viewing online at www.regulations.gov without change, unless the comment contains copyrighted material, CBI, or other information whose disclosure is restricted by statute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although not all docket materials may be available electronically, you may still access any publicly available docket materials through the EPA Docket Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing the official public docket and obtaining a copy
rubrics_metrics.description: The official public docket for this action under Docket ID No. EPA-HQ-OGC-2016-0642 contains a copy of the proposed settlement agreement and is available for public viewing at the Office of Environmental Information (OEI) Docket in the EPA Docket Center and electronically through www.regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The EPA Docket Center Public Reading Room is open 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday (excluding legal holidays). Telephone numbers are provided for the Public Reading Room and the OEI Docket; instructions on using www.regulations.gov to view docket contents are provided (key in docket identification number then select “search”).

rubrics_metrics.name: Once submitted comments cannot be edited or removed
rubrics_metrics.description: Once submitted, comments cannot be edited or removed from www.regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure your submission is complete and accurate before finalizing; consider including all attachments and written explanations in the primary submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact person for additional submission methods or questions
rubrics_metrics.description: For additional submission methods, please contact the person identified in the FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice provides a named contact (Emily Seidman) with phone, fax, and email for further information regarding submission or docket access.
